answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. Each agent wanting a job slot posts a 0.05 POA deposit that is burned when the slot closes. A slot lives for a fixed horizon of 30 days. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities pays 1,000 x 0.05 = 50 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays just 0.05 POA. The zenith of the design is that cost scales linearly with fakes, so the onyx ledger stays dark for attackers, while honest agents earn far more than the fee.
